notes.title: TGS and Updated Demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
[/p][p]This week is a very exciting one for me, as I’m getting ready to travel to Tokyo to show the Crude Oil demo at the Tokyo Game Show!
[/p][p]Don’t worry if you’re not going to be there, you can try the demo wherever you may be, just hit the button to download and experience the world as a glob of petroleum.[/p][p]
If you’d like to be the first to know about future playtests for the game you can [u][url="https://discord.gg/XSR9J5nn3N"]join us on discord[/url][/u], or if you’d prefer to wait until the full launch please give the game a wishlist and a follow. I would really appreciate it![/p]
